Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.coverage

Class StructuredCoverageManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.coverage.StructuredCoverageManager
public class StructuredCoverageManager extends AbstractManager
Manager for the GeoServer Structured Coverage (granule index) REST API (/rest/workspaces/{ws}/coveragestores/{cs}/coverages/{c}/index).

The Structured Coverage API manages the internal granule index of an ImageMosaic coverage store. ImageMosaic assembles multiple raster files (granules) into a single virtual coverage; this API supports schema inspection and granule listing/deletion.

Note: This API works only with stores that implement StructuredGridCoverage2DReader (primarily ImageMosaic). Calling it on a GeoTIFF, WorldImage, or RST store causes 500 Internal Server Error (ClassCastException in GeoServer).

Endpoints covered

 GET     /rest/workspaces/{ws}/coveragestores/{cs}/coverages/{c}/index
 GET     /rest/workspaces/{ws}/coveragestores/{cs}/coverages/{c}/index/granules
 GET     /rest/workspaces/{ws}/coveragestores/{cs}/coverages/{c}/index/granules/{granuleId}
 DELETE  /rest/workspaces/{ws}/coveragestores/{cs}/coverages/{c}/index/granules
 DELETE  /rest/workspaces/{ws}/coveragestores/{cs}/coverages/{c}/index/granules/{granuleId}

Typical usage


 IndexSchema schema = client.structuredCoverages().getSchema("myws", "mymosaic", "dem");
 GranuleCollection all = client.structuredCoverages().listGranules("myws", "mymosaic", "dem");
Since:
1.0.0

      public GranuleCollection listGranules(String workspaceName, String storeName, String coverageName, String filter, Integer offset, Integer limit)
      List granules with optional filter and paging.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - coverage store name (required)
      coverageName - coverage name (required)
      filter - ECQL filter expression (null returns all)

    • deleteGranules

      public void deleteGranules(String workspaceName, String storeName, String coverageName, String filter, String purge, boolean updateBBox)
      Bulk delete granules matching an ECQL filter.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - coverage store name (required)
      coverageName - coverage name (required)
      filter - ECQL filter expression (null deletes all)
      purge - file deletion policy: "none" (default), "metadata", "all"
      updateBBox - when true, recalculates nativeBoundingBox after deletion
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if workspaceName, storeName, or coverageName is null/empty
